architectural_declarations.algorithm_freezing: Phase 13 does not redesign, retune, replace, or modify the algorithms, thresholds, schemas, or training procedures of Phases 1-12. For runtime inference, Phase 13 deterministically bootstraps Phase 7 Isolation Forest and Phase 8 XGBoost model instances using the existing training procedures and synthetic simulator-generated data. distinctions.algorithm_training_procedure_freezing: Feature schemas, classifier configurations, EWMA thresholds, Theil-Sen estimator rules, and multi-modal fusion equations from Phases 1-12 remain unmodified.
distinctions.runtime_model_fitting: Deterministic synthetic bootstrap fitting is executed on synthetic simulator data with fixed seeds during orchestrator startup.
distinctions.pretrained_timesfm_weights: Gated external model weights remain unauthenticated in the local execution environment, preserving the explicit fallback path (BLOCKED_UNAUTHENTICATED_GATED) without fabricating weights.
